waveformDefinition.carrier: periodic band-limited noise-like carrier; independent QPSK spectral coefficients followed by IFFT
waveformDefinition.frequencySupport: FFT bins inside nominal bandwidth before rectangular sample-exact activity envelope
waveformDefinition.burstEnvelope: rectangular and sample exact; frequency leakage from gating is explicitly not occupied bandwidth truth
waveformDefinition.cnrDefinition: component active-period power / expected white-noise power within nominal BW; excludes other carriers
waveformDefinition.cnrCalibration: expected thermal-band CNR, not an exact measured total-interference CNR
waveformDefinition.amplitudeScaling: one file-wide gain giving peak complex component <=0.8 full scale
waveformDefinition.pcm: stereo little-endian PCM16 I then Q; no clipping; round nearest
